commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a build-readiness guard to `scripts/watch-node.mjs`, exposes it in `scripts/watch-node.d.mts`, and adds watch-node regression tests.

PR surface: Tests +148, Other +78. Total +226 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. The canonical issue gives a concrete source-checkout/systemd/git-update scenario, and current source shows the watcher can signal the child before `run-node` completes a replacement build; I did not run the destructive live race in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Human review is needed to choose the canonical watcher lifecycle repair and require contributor-owned real `gateway:watch` proof; the remaining blockers are design and proof decisions, not a small safe automation patch.

target.title: fix(gateway): defer hot-reload restart when dist/entry.js is missing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Pushing commits into a live production git checkout triggers the gateway's hot-reload while `dist/` is mid-rebuild. The watcher (`requestRestart()` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs`) immediately sends SIGTERM to the current healthy child process without checking whether the replacement build is valid for the new checkout state. The new child cannot start → crash-loop until systemd's start-limit is exhausted (37-min outage, P1, issue #99603).

## Changes

Two guard points using `isBuildReadyForRestart(cwd, fs, resolveHead)` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs`:

**Guard 1 — requestRestart()**: Before sending SIGTERM, verify `dist/entry.js` exists AND `dist/.buildstamp` git HEAD matches current checkout HEAD. If either check fails (mid-rebuild or stale build), skip the kill — the running process continues serving traffic.

**Guard 2 — Exit handler**: After SIGTERM/143 child exit, verify build readiness before restarting. Prevents self-reinforcing crash-loop.

**Scope**: Partial mitigation — prevents crash-loop but keeps stop-then-start ordering. Issue #99603 should remain open for transactional restart.

## Evidence

### Real `gateway:watch` terminal proof

```
GATEWAY:WATCH — REAL TERMINAL PROOF
Hostname: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
Node:     v24.13.1

─── 1. Guard function: isBuildReadyForRestart ───
  ✅ entry.js missing → false (expected false)
  ✅ entry exists, no readFileSync → true (expected true)
  ✅ build stamp HEAD mismatch → false (expected false)
  ✅ build stamp HEAD match → true (expected true)

─── 2. Source code guard verification ───
  Guard check calls: 2 (requestRestart + exit handler)
  Guard log messages: 2
  Exported: 1

─── 3. Lint check ───
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

─── 4. Unit tests ───
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  24 passed (24)
```

### Unit tests (24/24 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/watch-node.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  24 passed (24)
```

### Broader regression (91/91 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/run-node.test.ts src/infra/watch-node.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  91 passed (91)
```

### CI status (30 checks, 0 failed)

All `checks-node-compact-small-*` pass. Lint and type-check clean.

## Review

- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
- Partial mitigation; issue #99603 should remain open
